provenance.title: MER Pancam Science Derived Atmospheric Opacity Data Bundle
provenance.instrument: Pancam right camera, 880 nm solar filter (target: Sun)
provenance.units: atmospheric opacity tau (dimensionless); sol = Martian days since landing
provenance.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Cornell; archived by the PDS Geosciences Node
provenance.processing: All rows parsed; median tau per integer sol (floor of LOCAL_TIME); n = measurements that sol. No interpolation.
provenance.note: This product ends on sol 5106 (June 5, 2018). The tau of about 10.8 on June 10, 2018 is a separate JPL estimate, not part of this table.
